# Risk memo: Diversified global

_Deterministic template memo. Verified: 0 unsupported numbers, 49 figures traced to code._

## Summary

Diversified global holds 7 positions (SPY, EFA, EEM, AGG, GLD, VNQ, TLT) and is compared with SPY. Between 2016-11-01 and 2026-10-29 it grew at 9.33% a year with annualized volatility of 11.73%, and its worst peak-to-trough loss was -23.16%. SPY is 30.00% of the weight but 42.24% of the volatility.

## Return and risk profile

The Sharpe ratio is 0.57 and the Sortino ratio is 1.15, using a risk-free rate of 3.00%. The benchmark grew at 15.58% a year with volatility of 17.95% and a maximum drawdown of -33.72%. Beta to the benchmark is 0.60. The maximum drawdown ran from 2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23 and lasted 105 trading days in total. The effective number of independent risk bets is 3.80. Daily returns have skewness of -0.66 and excess kurtosis of 16.96; positive excess kurtosis means fatter tails than a normal distribution.

## Tail risk

On a typical bad day (1-day, 95% confidence, historical) the portfolio loses at least 1.05%, and the average loss on those days is 1.72%. At 99% confidence the historical VaR is 1.89% and the Expected Shortfall 3.08%, against a normal-distribution VaR of 1.72%. The 10-day 95% historical VaR is 3.04%. In a rolling backtest the 95% historical VaR was exceeded on 131 days against 113.2 expected (Kupiec verdict: consistent); at 99% the verdict is consistent. Over the next 252 trading days, a simulation assuming 5.00% annual drift gives a 32.98% chance of a loss, a median return of 4.95% and a 8.77% chance of a drawdown deeper than one fifth of value.

## Stress and regimes

Of 4 historical stress scenarios with enough history, the worst was Global Financial Crisis: the portfolio returned -31.46% against -46.04% for the benchmark. A regime model on the benchmark puts the market in a Calm regime (90.37% probability); in Stress regimes this portfolio's volatility is 6.3x its Calm level. In a walk-forward volatility test the best forecaster was GARCH-t, which forecasts annualized volatility of 8.01% for the next month.

## Disclosed risks from filings

No 10-K filings are indexed for these holdings (ETFs and funds do not file them).

## Caveats and limitations

- All figures are historical estimates from daily data between 2016-11-01 and 2026-10-29; future losses can be larger.
- Value at Risk and Expected Shortfall assume the past is representative of the future; the normal-distribution versions understate fat tails.
- Monte Carlo results depend on the assumed annual return of 5.00% and resample past daily returns.
- Regimes come from a hidden Markov model fitted to the benchmark; the current regime uses only data up to the last date.
- Disclosed risks summarize the latest 10-K risk factors; ETFs and funds have none.

_Educational tool, not investment advice. Models are simplifications; historical risk measures can understate future losses._
